title: Marlowe Rewards Points Reversal Entries: Desk Note and Tool Reference
content:
## Situation

The situation is a return of an order that earned Marlowe Rewards points: the return has been refunded, and no points reversal stands on the points ledger for that return and order. In that situation the agent posts the reversal for that return and order.

The reversal concerns the member's return in status settled and the order that return was made against. A reversal is posted:

- only while the membership is in status active or suspended; and
- only once per return and order.

## What the entry does

The tool posts one reversal entry on the member's points ledger, dated and available today. The entry:

- names the return and the order;
- debits the points given, so the membership's points balance falls by that number and may go below zero; and
- records the refunded merchandise amount it is based on and the earning multiplier it refers to.

The member sees the deduction on their points history at once.

## Invocation

`post_points_reversal_46de2c04` is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | The Marlowe Rewards membership number whose points are taken back, as shown by the membership lookup | Identifier |
| `return_id` | The return (RMA) number whose refund caused the reversal, as shown by the return lookup | Identifier |
| `order_id` | The order number the returned merchandise came from, as shown by the return or order lookup | Identifier |
| `points_reversed` | The number of points to take back | A positive whole number, booked as a debit in signed whole points, so 40 is recorded as a deduction of 40 |
| `reversed_spend_usd` | The refunded merchandise amount the reversal is based on | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `tier_multiplier_applied` | The earning multiplier recorded on the order's original earning entry | A decimal with 2 decimal places, for example 1.50 |

## Return

The tool returns a one-line text receipt. It names the new points-entry reference, the whole points debited, the order and the return, and the membership's whole-point balance after the entry. The receipt appearing means the entry was booked.
